name: Google Ads MCP Server
description: Enables interaction with Google Ads through secure OAuth authentication to discover keyword ideas, analyze historical search metrics, and generate forecasts for advertising campaigns. Built as a Next.js application with encrypted credential storage and rate limiting.

rawRecord.description: Enables interaction with Google Ads through secure OAuth authentication to discover keyword ideas, analyze historical search metrics, and generate forecasts for advertising campaigns. Built as a Next.js application with encrypted credential storage and rate limiting.

NEXTAUTH_URL.description: Optional explicit base URL. When omitted the server uses the incoming request origin.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Base64 encoded 32-byte key for AES-256-GCM. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

GADS_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth client ID created in Google Cloud Console.

GADS_DEV_TOKEN.description: Google Ads developer token approved for production.

KV_REST_API_URL.description: Vercel KV REST endpoint. Omit to use in-memory storage locally.

KV_REST_API_TOKEN.description: Vercel KV REST token with read/write permissions.

GADS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth client secret that matches the client ID.

NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_NAME.description: Display name shown on the OAuth confirmation page.

GADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID.description: Optional manager account ID used for scoped access.

KV_REST_API_READ_ONLY_TOKEN.description: Optional read-only token for GET operations.
